venues.name: West Coast USA: BMP dirt arena
venues.notes: Open, flat, fenced dusty-dirt arena, at least 64 x 64 m.

venues.name: West Coast USA: BMP Gravel Track
venues.notes: Purpose-built rallycross venue: gravel track 14-16 m wide with a tarmac start line, berms, a jump and 9 layouts. The spawn faces down the start straight, which is flat only for its first ~50 m: it cambers from 60 m and banks 9-16 degrees from 100 m (measured 0.39.4). Drills that stop go on the run-up venue (below) or stop within ~45 m of the line.

venues.name: West Coast USA: BMP Gravel Track, run-up
venues.notes: 120 m behind the start line on the gravel run-up, facing the line. Flat (roll under 0.5 degrees) from 60 m before the line to 50 m past it; stops belong there, before the straight cambers and banks. Clear for 150 m ahead (measured 0.39.4).

venues.name: West Coast USA: BMP Gravel Track, downhill left
venues.notes: 67 m of straight approach (8 m wide gravel) into a 124 degree downhill left, radius 32 m, 110 m long, dropping about 12 m, that exits onto the circuit's north-east straight (road network DR1181; measured 0.39.4). Gravel about 5 m either side of the centre line, then dirt and grass.

venues.name: West Coast USA: BMP dirt circle
venues.notes: About 50 m circular dusty-dirt infield, dead flat: a natural skidpad.

venues.name: West Coast USA: BMP dirt circle, on a 15 m ring
venues.notes: The dirt circle's south edge, 15 m from its centre (265, 40.05) and facing east: the start of an anticlockwise lap of a 15 m ring. Dirt to 23 m or more from the centre all round, the nearest obstacle 30 m out (measured 0.39.4).

venues.name: West Coast USA: BMP dirt circle, arc approach
venues.notes: The dirt circle's south-west edge, facing east along the tangent of a 15 m ring round the centre (265, 40.05): 25 m of straight approach into a left-hand quarter of the ring, then north across the infield (measured 0.39.4).

venues.name: West Coast USA: gravel lane, tightening right
venues.notes: The start of gravel lane DR825 off DR687, west of the town (-860, -68), facing east: 35 m to a right-hander whose radius tightens from about 60 m to 18 m over a small crest, then drops away downhill. About 6 m of gravel, trees close on the outside in places (measured 0.39.4).

venues.name: West Coast USA: gravel lane, opening left
venues.notes: The same lane (DR825) at node 13, facing north up the slope: 15 m to a 19 m-radius left-hander that opens steadily onto a straight (radius 20, 25, 37, 69 m). About 6 m of gravel (measured 0.39.4).

venues.name: West Coast USA: Quarry
venues.notes: Gravel haul roads, terraces and spoil heaps; Spiral Descent for gradients. Cluttered.

venues.name: West Coast USA: Off-Road Circuit
venues.notes: Rough dusty-dirt figure-eight with jumps and crests.

venues.name: West Coast USA: Off-Road Circuit, blind crest hairpin
venues.notes: On the circuit's north straight (road node dirttrack_16), 85 m before a left hairpin that turns 180 degrees across a crest (159.6 m, nodes dirttrack_19a-19b) and drops away 25 % into its exit: the exit can't be seen from the approach. Walled, about 10 m wide (measured 0.39.4).

venues.name: West Coast USA: Off-Road Circuit, kicker crest
venues.notes: On the circuit's south-east descent (road node dirttrack_11, about 7 % down), 110 m before a short kicker crest (nodes dirttrack_15a-15b: 24 % up, 18 % down, 2.3 m high) after a left-hander. The Covet Gravel Rally stays down to about 56 km/h and takes off from about 60 km/h (0.3 s at 62); walled, about 10 m wide (measured 0.39.4).

venues.name: Utah: NGRC Rally Utah 2026 stages
venues.notes: The four NGRC 2026 gravel stages; the spawn is at SS1 Deer Creek (river crossings).
